import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_3.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
# Each source has schema: ['Wrestler', 'Wins', 'Losses', 'Draws']
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# The target schema has columns for 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 stats.
# Each source corresponds to one year:
# Source0 -> 2013
# Source1 -> 2014
# Source2 -> 2015
# Source3 -> 2016

# Rename columns in each source to match target schema for that year
dfs[0] = dfs[0].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

dfs[1] = dfs[1].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

dfs[2] = dfs[2].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

dfs[3] = dfs[3].rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Now join all four DataFrames on 'Wrestler' using outer join to keep all wrestlers
# This is because some wrestlers may appear in some years but not others
df_merged = dfs[0]
for df in dfs[1:]:
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df, on='Wrestler', how='outer')

# Fill NaN values with 0 for all numeric columns (wins, losses, draws)
# Wrestler column is string, so no fill needed there
numeric_cols = df_merged.columns.drop('Wrestler')
df_merged[numeric_cols] = df_merged[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Wrestler',
    '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
    '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Write the final DataFrame to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all sources
df_union = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY Wrestler and sum Wins, Losses, Draws
df_grouped = df_union.groupby("Wrestler", as_index=False).agg({
    "Wins": "sum",
    "Losses": "sum",
    "Draws": "sum"
})

# Create final dataframe with target schema columns
# Target columns:
# ['Wrestler', '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws', '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
#  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws', '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

# Since source tables have no year info, assign all aggregated values to 2013 columns, others zero
df_final = pd.DataFrame()
df_final["Wrestler"] = df_grouped["Wrestler"]
df_final["2013 Wins"] = df_grouped["Wins"]
df_final["2013 Losses"] = df_grouped["Losses"]
df_final["2013 Draws"] = df_grouped["Draws"]

# Fill other year columns with zeros
for year in ["2014", "2015", "2016"]:
    df_final[f"{year} Wins"] = 0
    df_final[f"{year} Losses"] = 0
    df_final[f"{year} Draws"] = 0

# Write output
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
